creative_direction: Show Dekisugi at his familiar school-child age, with neatly parted dark hair and a plain blue collared shirt. He holds an unlettered notebook against his chest and looks directly toward the viewer with a small friendly smile. Keep his face proportions unchanged and the eyes clear above the book. Use restrained oatmeal gouache surroundings and no academic badges, readable pages, or extra props. Use matte gouache, short deliberate brush marks, and a softly mottled but uncluttered background. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
